judged_text: Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#update passes the nil returned by the id lookup straight into save_host, which calls nil.host= and raises NoMethodError. An admin who saves an edit after another admin (or another tab) already deleted that host receives a 500 with an internal-server-error popup instead of a 404 or a rendered validation error.
